text: Derek was one node. Whatever happened to him at Viral Dynamics, the network kept moving. Ghost is proof.
style: Intelligence handler giving a mission debrief in person. Speak with a consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Quick, clipped and businesslike because time is short, yet completely unflustered; the urgency is in the pace, never in the voice.
